description:
At CF&I Steel, L.P., our strength starts with our people! As a team we collaborate to solve problems, contribute ideas and challenge each other to ensure growth and ultimately success for the business and our employees. 
 
 
 Job Description and Responsibilities 
 We are seeking a qualified Oracle APEX Developer for our Rocky Mountain Steel Mills in Pueblo, CO. The Oracle APEX Developer will work closely with business and plant personnel to design, enhance, and support systems that improve production and operational performance. You'll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions, modernize systems, and improve business performance across a diverse steel manufacturing and recycling network. 

 Research and design software systems in support of the production, quality and shipping activities for our products 
 Troubleshooting, maintaining and enhancing MIS applications as required 
 Performing other software development duties as necessary 
 Schedule and attend meetings with Operation, Quality, Maintenance and Shipping users to develop software requirements 
 Provide training and support for custom application to manufacturing personnel 
 Providing computer application development and maintenance using Oracle Forms/Reports, Oracle PL/SQL, SQL 
 Develop and deploy DSI mobile application to Barcode and RFID scanners, tablets and mobile computers 
 Performs other duties as they might be assigned
 
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field 
 Minimum 1-2 years of experience designing, developing and deploying applications within a Oracle Developer Suite 11g environment 
 Experience with data modeling, PL/QL, Java Script and general web development is required 
 Oracle APEX, JSON/ RESTful Web Services and Linux/UNIX scripting development experience 
 Experience with relational databases, Oracle 12C preferred  
 Experience in program design including object oriented design 
 Manufacturing experience 
 Manufacturing experience in steel industry, preferred 
 Compensation 
 $107,000 - $115,000
 Open & Closing Dates 
10/1/2026 - 11/13/2026

 
 
 Our total compensation package includes amazing benefits!
 Competitive wages and bonus opportunities 
 Family medical, dental, and prescription coverage at minimal employee cost 
 Short and long term disability programs 
 Competitive retirement plans 
 Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts 
 Employer-provided and Voluntary Life Insurance options 
 Paid vacation and recognized statutory holidays 
 Apprenticeship and career advancement within the company 
 Tuition reimbursement 
 Wellness program 
 
 All applicants must be eligible to work in the USA. 
 
 While we thank all those who apply, only those being actively considered for employment will be contacted. 
 
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 Orion Steel Group, L.L.C. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. 
   
 Orion Steel Group, L.L.C. is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. 
 If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please e-mail careers@orionsteel.com or call: (312) 533-3577. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis. 
 
 Join a team that manufactures excellence, drives success and builds careers!
